Unfortunately not. Live plants can't be shipped to PO boxes, so a monstera needs a street address (such as home, work, or a friend's place).

With a street address, Express is available for Zones 1 and 2 at $14.95 (never free). It arrives next business day in Zone 1 or in 2 business days in Zone 2. It isn't available for Zone 3 (over 1,000 miles, remote and island addresses). Live plants ship Monday to Wednesday only, and orders placed after 12 noon Wednesday ship the following Monday.
